description: This file defines the Manufacturer entity class used in the sales management core system, representing a manufacturer with related properties, persistence annotations, and relationships to descriptions and merchant store.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Entity class representing a manufacturer, including properties like image, order, descriptions, and associated merchant store, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the manufacturer.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section information for auditing purposes.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer image URL or path.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the manufacturer image URL or path.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the collection of manufacturer descriptions.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this manufacturer.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Gets the sorting order of the manufacturer.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order of the manufacturer.
